name: St Mary, Langho, St Mary, Osbaldeston and English Martyrs
shortName: St Mary, Langho, St Mary, Osbaldeston and English Martyrs

boundary.description:
From the confluence of the River Ribble and the River Calder at Hacking Hall, by River Ribble to its confluence with the brook between Shuttleworth Farm and ‘Fishes and Peggy Hill’. SE  in a straight line (excluding Standen Hey Farm but including Barrow Gardens) to the junction of  Whalley Road with the A671 and the A59. SE by a straight line to the trigonometry pillar 315m  near Jeppe Knave Grave, SW to the road at Wiswell Moor Houses and by this road to the track to Lower Clerk Hill Farm,
SE  along Sabden Brook  to Read Old Bridge crossing Old Roman Road and to Read New Bridge crossing A671 to its confluence with the River Calder. From Cock Bridge  crossing A680 downstream to its confluence with Dean Brook NW by Heys Farm and Berrys Lane to Shawcliffe Lane. SW  along the Ribble Valley / Hyndburn civil boundary, to  York Road,  Rishton Road and N along Hollowhead Lane, crossing Whalley New Road A666 then along  Ribchester Road B6245. SW at Clayton Hey Farm and by the footpath W of the Sewerage Works. W by Showley Brook to and S by Saccary Lane, Zechariah Brow  and Barker Lane. W by Arley Brook and the Ribble Valley - Blackburn with Darwen civil boundary crossing Preston New Road A677 just north of Yew Tree Drive A6119 to the Ribble Valley - Blackburn with Darwen civil boundary then to the Ribble Valley - South Ribble civil boundary to where it crosses Further Lane near Alum Scar Lane then by a  straight line north to Higher Barn Farm (presently KFC takeaway) crossing Preston New Road by a straight line NW  across Samlesbury airfield to meet the Ribble Valley - South Ribble civil boundary  at Myerscough Smithy on the A59, then by Ribble Valley - South Ribble civil boundary to the River Ribble at Spring Wood upsteam to the confluence with the River Calder at Hacking Hall.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between English Martyrs and St Mary, Langho
internalBoundaries.description: From the boundary stone on Shawcliffe Lane  to the lane from Whalley Old Rd and to the junction of Elker Lane and Whalley New road (Pasturelands Drive being in English Martyrs) to the bridge over the A59,thence by a bee-line N to the weir opposite the sewage works on the River Calder. By this to its confluence with the River Ribble
